morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic cluster faces severe propane cost shock and plunging exports amid selective large-player recovery.
what_changed: Propane gas prices surged by Rs 7,300 per tonne ahead of Diwali, creating a severe input-cost shock for Morbi manufacturers.
Indian ceramic tile export volumes dropped steeply by 46% during April-July 2026, with a weak full-year FY27 outlook.
Varmora Granito reported a 498% jump in H1 profit driven by premium tile margins.
stress_signals: Propane prices spiked by Rs 7,300 per tonne ahead of Diwali, threatening operating margins [7b1fa98f465f].
Export volumes fell 46% between April and July 2026, signaling prolonged weakness in overseas demand [434975bd08e0].
A Morbi manufacturer faced a fraud loss of Rs 44.74 lakh after a credit buyer defaulted and became unreachable [29ed75c6450d].
improvement_signals: Varmora Granito's financial results indicate a broader ceramic tile industry recovery, led by premium tile margins [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c].
what_to_watch: Monitor sustainability of high propane prices post-Diwali and pass-through capability of MSMEs.
Track export order flows and realization trends for non-branded tile manufacturers.
Scrutinize credit sales terms and debtor aging reports to prevent buyer fraud and payment defaults.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces raw material cost shocks and embroidery labor disputes amid diversification.
what_changed: Textile manufacturers began producing defence technical textiles for the Indian Army.
A 50% raw material cost spike prompted loom shutdowns affecting 75,000 workers ahead of Diwali.
The GST Council granted ITC refunds and eased highway inspections for Surat textiles.
stress_signals: Surat textile slump and raw material cost spike drove a month-long loom shutdown affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6].
Embroidery sector faced a prolonged three-month labour dispute and ongoing impasse disrupting job-work cash inflows [8a31a5a2c20c, e7921383cbb7].
Diamond artisans and units reported localized wage default issues ahead of Diwali [402ab705574d, 698c779932f2].
improvement_signals: Surat textile units commenced production of defence fabrics for the Indian Army [4966bee026d8, 0f163b499572].
GST Council provided relief via ITC refunds and reduced highway inspections [17f0a015a73c].
ICA-GemLab is set to open its first Indian testing laboratory in Surat [26bd1ecd549c].
what_to_watch: Monitor debt service capacity and machine-loan repayments in the embroidery sector due to the ongoing labor dispute.
Track implementation details and operational impacts of the upcoming state or central textile policies.
Observe inventory levels and demand recovery post-Diwali following the reported loom shutdowns and power constraints.
